items.title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE We are seeking experienced and highly motivated Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to join our Cloud Infrastructure organization and drive the delivery of complex, high-impact infrastructure programs. As Mistral continues to scale its AI compute infrastructure, bringing new capacity online quickly and reliably is critical to our success. This involves not only deploying physical infrastructure but also coordinating the engineering efforts required to make that infrastructure fully operational. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cloud engineering, software infrastructure, and data center deployments, ensuring seamless execution across multiple technical teams. You will coordinate programs involving networking, storage, Kubernetes, fleet management, and infrastructure operations, working closely with engineering teams to manage dependencies, anticipate risks, and accelerate the deployment of production-ready compute capacity. The TPM role spans several critical areas of program management: Cloud Infrastructure Deployment – Coordinate the software deployment and bring-up of new compute infrastructure, ensuring smooth transitions from physical data center deployment to fully operational cloud environments. Technical Program Management – Plan, execute, and oversee complex infrastructure programs involving multiple engineering teams, managing dependencies, timelines, and technical risks to ensure successful delivery. Cross-Functional Engineering Coordination – Work closely with Cloud Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure, Networking, Storage, Kubernetes, and Fleet teams to align priorities, resolve blockers, and drive execution. Engineering Operations & Process Improvement – Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure deployment processes, improve coordination, and introduce scalable, lightweight workflows that accelerate delivery. LOCATION & OFFICE POLICY The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours. WHAT YOU WILL DO Program Management — Lead and coordinate complex cloud infrastructure programs, from physical infrastructure handover through software deployment and production readiness. Infrastructure Deployment — Oversee the software bring-up of newly deployed compute infrastructure, coordinating engineering teams responsible for networking, storage, Kubernetes, fleet delivery, and infrastructure health. Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with Cloud Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure, and other technical teams to ensure alignment across deployment activities, technical dependencies, and operational priorities. Project Delivery — Define and track project milestones, timelines, and resources. Anticipate blockers, coordinate technical dependencies, and ensure infrastructure is brought into production efficiently and reliably. Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve deployment workflows, reduce time to production, and establish scalable processes that support our growing infrastructure needs. Stakeholder Management — Maintain clear communication with engineering teams, technical leads, and leadership, providing visibility into program progress, risks, and key decisions. Risk Management — Proactively identify technical and operational risks, develop mitigation strategies, and drive the resolution of critical issues that could delay infrastructure availability. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - You hold a degree in a relevant scientific or technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline). - You have at least 4 years of relevant experience managing technical programs, preferably in cloud infrastructure, software infrastructure, data centers, GPU computing, hosting, or related environments. - You have proven experience coordinating complex technical projects involving multiple engineering teams and interdependent workstreams. - You have a strong understanding of infrastructure deployment processes and the technical challenges involved in bringing systems into production. - You have excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex programs and drive execution in fast-paced environments. - You thrive in cross-functional collaboration and can effectively communicate with engineers, technical leads, and senior stakeholders. - You are highly organized and know how to manage cross-team dependencies, anticipate blockers, and keep projects moving forward. - You are a proactive problem-solver with a continuous improvement mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking ownership. Ideally, you have: - Experience managing cloud infrastructure or large-scale data center deployment programs. - A background in cloud engineering, software infrastructure, platform engineering, or a related technical field. - Familiarity with Kubernetes, networking, storage systems, distributed systems, or infrastructure automation. - Experience working on GPU infrastructure, HPC environments, or large-scale compute deployments. - Experience coordinating projects involving both physical infrastructure and software engineering teams. - Previous experience as a Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, SRE, or Technical Program Manager. - Already worked in an AI company or on large-scale AI infrastructure projects. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Sr. Security Risk Management Analyst
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s world-class Security Team is growing. As we continue to scale and mature our information technology controls program, we are seeking a senior professional with a strong background in risk management to help build and operate a program designed for enterprise scale. Kraken is seeking a Senior Risk Analyst to join the Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SecGRC) team. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Security Risk Management, this role is a key contributor to the execution and maturation of Kraken's Security Risk Management program. You'll conduct rigorous risk assessments, produce high-quality analysis, and help build the operational infrastructure that makes the program run — all in close partnership with program leadership. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact both within Kraken and across the broader industry. The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, process-minded, and energized by turning ambiguous risk signals into clear, repeatable, and scalable workflows. Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort with iterating quickly is a must. This is a fully remote role. THE OPPORTUNITY - Execute security risk assessments end-to-end — scoping, data gathering, analysis, findings documentation, and communicating results to stakeholders — in alignment with program methodology set by leadership - Support the development and continuous refinement of risk assessment templates, workflows, and process guides that make the program consistent and scalable - Maintain risk registers and ensure identified risks are tracked accurately and progressing through mitigation, remediation, or acceptance workflows - Assist in building and maintaining Key Risk Indicators (KRI) tracking and risk reporting outputs, translating raw data into clear, well-structured deliverables for review by senior leadership - Partner with technical teams including Vulnerability Management, Application Security, and Blue Team to gather risk-relevant data and incorporate operational findings into assessment work - Identify opportunities to streamline and automate risk processes and bring those recommendations to program leadership for prioritization - Contribute to the documentation and upkeep of risk program standards, procedures, and guidance materials - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Compliance, Internal Audit, Engineering, and Legal to ensure risk findings are well-contextualized and properly actioned - Support audit preparedness activities and risk-related reporting as directed by program leadership WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in information security risk management, cybersecurity governance, or GRC - Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments and owning findings documentation — not just supporting assessments, but running them - Strong working knowledge of risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27005, PCI DSS, or DoCRA - Demonstrated ability to build repeatable processes — you've taken something ad hoc and made it structured and scalable - Strong data analysis skills; able to clean, interpret, and present risk data clearly and accurately - Experience contributing to KRI tracking and risk reporting for internal stakeholder audiences - Familiarity with GRC tools such as AuditBoard, Archer, OneTrust, or ServiceNow GRC - Proficient in Google Workspace; SQL and/or Tableau experience a strong plus - Excellent written communication — your deliverables are clear, well-organized, and don't require heavy editing - Self-directed and comfortable operating in ambiguity; you take direction well and run with it - Bachelor's degree or above in IT, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field - CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 credentials a plus; experience in fintech or regulated industries preferred Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We are looking for a Security GRC Lead to own security governance, risk, and compliance across Payward's acquisitions. You will be the accountable owner for bringing each acquired company from its own control environment into ours, working with the M&A Technology Team from diligence through to either full platform migration or steady-state coverage under our central program. Payward acquires and integrates companies continuously, across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes. Every target arrives with its own controls, its own maturity level and its own audit history, and every one enters our financial statement audit scope on a timeline set by the deal rather than by readiness. Today that work competes for the same people who run controls for the parent company. This role exists so that it has a dedicated owner. This is a build role to uphold the repeatable process for assessing an acquired company against our security baseline, mapping its controls into our compliance frameworks,and setting remediation milestones a newly acquired team can realistically hit. You will then run it, deal after deal, and you are accountable for the work getting done. THE OPPORTUNITY - Assess each acquisition target against Payward's security baseline, during diligence where deal timelines allow and immediately post-close otherwise - Map the acquired company's existing controls to Payward's control framework, and identify gaps against the external frameworks the entity falls under once in scope - Score control maturity at the entity level and document the basis for each score - Define remediation milestones that are achievable for the acquired team's size and maturity, sequenced by risk reduction rather than by framework order - Track milestones to closure and report status to Security GRC leadership and the M&A Technology Team - Recommend the endpoint for each entity: full migration onto Payward platforms, or uplift to a maturity level the central program can absorb - Load acquired-entity risks into the enterprise risk register and keep them current - Prepare acquired entities for inclusion in external audit scope, including evidence collection and walkthrough support - Act as the Security GRC point of contact for acquired-entity leadership, finance, and internal audit - Maintain policy coverage for acquired entities, including building entity-specific policy libraries where the parent policy set does not apply cleanly - Feed recurring findings back into the diligence process, so later deals are assessed against known patterns - Document the onboarding process so that it is repeatable and not dependent on one person WHAT WILL YOU DO - Target Assessment - Review target security posture during diligence: control environment, identity and access management, infrastructure, third-party dependencies, and prior audit or examination history - Produce a written assessment of each target against the Payward security baseline, separating the risks that matter to the deal from those that matter to steady-state operations - Give the M&A Technology Team and deal sponsors a clear read on what integration will cost in control remediation terms - Control Mapping and Framework Onboarding - Map acquired controls to Payward's framework and to the external frameworks the entity becomes subject to - Identify which parent-company controls extend to the entity as they are, which need an entity-specific variant, and which have no equivalent at all - Build the entity's policy library where the parent policy set does not cover it - Remediation and Milestones - Set milestones the acquired team can meet, each with a date, an owner, and a stated risk reduction - Sequence work so that the highest-risk gaps close first rather than the easiest ones - Run the cadence for tracking remediation and escalating overdue or material risks Prepare proposed risk acceptances, including the rationale and compensating controls, and present them to leadership for decision - Program Integration - Prepare entities for external audit inclusion and support fieldwork - Keep acquired-entity risk visible in the enterprise risk register and in Security GRC reporting - Hand each entity over to central GRC coverage once its maturity supports it, with the handover documented - Integrate 3rd parties and vendors into Payward WHAT YOU BRING - 5-7+ years in security governance, IT risk, or compliance, including regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environments - Direct experience onboarding an acquired company into an existing controls or compliance program. This is the core of the role - Working knowledge of SOX/ICFR IT general controls and what external auditors accept as evidence - Experience with at least two of ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS, including mapping controls across frameworks - Ability to assess control maturity and set remediation plans the receiving team completes, including teams below Payward's maturity level - Hands-on delivery: you write the scope, collect the evidence, and close gaps yourself when needed - Sound judgment on priorities with incomplete information, and the sense to escalate decisions that need leadership - Ability to build working relationships with control owners in IAM, infrastructure, and engineering - Ability to translate control gaps into risk language that deal teams and executives can act on - Strong project management across cross-functional, distributed teams - Preferred - CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer - M&A or post-merger technology integration experience - Familiarity with PKM WHY THIS ROLE - You will own a domain end to end rather than supporting someone else's. There is no incumbent process and no one else doing this work today - Acquisitions are one of the fastest-moving parts of the business, and security integration sits on the critical path for each one - You will work directly with deal teams, acquired-company leadership, external auditors, and Security GRC leadership, with visibility into how acquisitions are evaluated and closed - Payward is preparing for public company reporting, which means the controls you put in place at acquired entities are the ones external auditors will test - The scope of this role grows with the acquisition pipeline, across jurisdictions and regulatory regimes - You will join a remote-first, international team Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM You will join the AI4Engineering Science team, the Mistral research group that builds the data and evaluation infrastructure and owns the SFT/RL processes for AI4Engineering that teach our frontier LLMs to do real engineering work. The agentic engineering group works alongside the Physics AI research in the wider Science organisation. This seat sits in the agentic CAD stream. Together with the Solutions and Applied teams, the group carries this work into customer projects with industrial partners in automotive, aerospace, semiconductors, and beyond. THE ROLE Mistral is looking for an AI Scientist with deep machine learning expertise and hands-on CAD experience to expand what our agentic tools can do for computer-aided design. Your focus is a single mission: teaching Mistral's LLMs to generate, analyze, and modify CAD designs the way an expert design engineer would. Your core work is building the pre- and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real CAD tasks: text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation from technical drawings, geometric analysis and QA of CAD parts, and modification of existing designs. Because Mistral trains its own frontier LLMs, the data and verifiers you design ship directly into models you can hold - a rare position, and the core of the job. Alongside this, you will help shape the agent architectures and harnesses that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step CAD workflows, driving CAD tools through APIs or computer use across the whole design loop. This is early-stage work, and that's the point: you are joining at the foundation, shaping the data, verifiers, and agent scaffolding that decide whether these systems become reliable or stay demo-grade. There is no inherited playbook; you will help define what good looks like, and your work will set the direction the CAD stream builds on rather than extend an existing one. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for CAD tasks: text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation from technical drawings, geometric analysis and QA of CAD parts, and design modification - Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for CAD tasks - Scale the data pipelines that produce agentic CAD training traces - Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call CAD tools via API or computer use, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon design workflows - Build and maintain CAD evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling, from parametric CAD and drawing-to-3D benchmarks to industrial evaluations, identifying where models fail and tracing those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding - Collaborate with CAD domain experts and the CAE and EDA streams (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which CAD workflows are highest-value to target next - Contribute to Mistral's broader pre- and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Deep, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development: you have built LLM training pipelines (SFT, RL, fine-tuning, GRPO), demonstrated in publications or shipped systems rather than CV claims - Demonstrated hands-on CAD experience: you have designed, scripted, or automated real CAD workflows in tools such as SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, FreeCAD, or CADQuery, ideally with CAD-kernel grounding (OpenCASCADE, build123d) - Fluent English with excellent communication skills: you can explain technical ML and CAD concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences - You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments - Self-directed: you do not need detailed roadmaps to make progress - Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of CAD and ML It would be great if you: - Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks) - Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training - Have first-author publications or open-source benchmark work in agentic CAD or CAD-ML, such as CAD generation benchmarks or RL/GRPO fine-tuning of vision-language models for CAD - Have contributed to a large open-source or industry codebase - Have publications in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, JFM, AIAA, etc.) WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. items.location_text: London, United States, New York, United Kingdom
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves. As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges. You’ll be responsible for: - Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning. - Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team. - AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right. - Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done. REQUIREMENTS We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require: - Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent). - Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue. - Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence. - Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it. - Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment. Bonus: - Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection. - Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building. - Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline. LOCATION This role is remote. London or New York preferred. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We support some of OpenAI’s most important external audiences, including enterprises, founders, developers, technical communities, journalists, creators, and policymakers. Our work spans proactive storytelling, media relations, executive communications, launches, events, case studies, and campaigns that build awareness, understanding, and trust. About the Role We’re seeking a strategic, hands-on communications leader to help shape and deliver OpenAI’s B2B communications across EMEA. This role will report to the Head of B2B Comms, EMEA and will be a senior member of a small, high-impact regional communications team. The B2B Comms Lead, EMEA will build awareness, understanding and trust with business audiences by showing how organisations across the region are using OpenAI to transform how they work, serve customers and create value. The role will connect OpenAI’s global priorities with the needs of EMEA markets, combining clear strategy with excellent day-to-day execution. This person will work cross-functionally with B2B and global communications, GTM, marketing, product, legal, global affairs and country communications teams. International travel will be required. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Investigator in Coinbase’s Financial Intelligence Unit within Compliance (2LoD), you’ll help drive Coinbase’s financial crime investigations capability across multiple jurisdictions. This team leads complex reactive and proactive investigations, develops intelligence on emerging typologies and risk patterns, and translates investigative insights into high-quality SAR/STR decisions, escalations and programme improvements. You’ll work on high-impact matters across Coinbase’s global platform, partnering closely with MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and cross functional stakeholders to protect Coinbase and its customers from financial crime. What you’ll do: Own end-to-end investigations into complex AML/CFT matters, from alert review or referral, through case development, disposition and SAR/STR submission to relevant FIUs. Conduct delegated MLRO reviews of Suspicious Transaction Reports and Suspicious Activity Reports prior to filing, ensuring accuracy, quality and regulatory defensibility. Lead proactive investigations, using transaction data, on-chain activity, trading behaviour and cross functional intelligence and OSINT to identify emerging typologies, threat patterns and high-risk activity. Develop actionable intelligence from casework and analytics to inform escalations, regulatory reporting, control enhancements and improvements to detection and investigation workflows. Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy. Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing. Support investigation quality through case review, structured feedback and contributions to policies, procedures, training and programme maturity. Required Skills and Experience: 4+ years conducting and reviewing complex crypto financial crime investigations including experience across a range of products such as retail and institutional transfers, spot trading and derivatives. Experience preparing, reviewing and filing SARs/STRs with strong understanding of multi-jurisdiction AML/CTF regulatory obligations and reporting expectations. Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions. Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences. Experience identifying financial crime typologies, contributing to proactive investigations and turning investigative findings into programme or control improvements. Utilises generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re part of Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands. At DigiOutsource, we bring passionate people and innovative tech together to create market-leading online gaming solutions. Our multidisciplinary teams are passionate about products, customer experience and security. We’re empowered to achieve the ultimate in high-performance gaming experiences using the best technology available. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At DigiOutsource, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re on a mission to create extraordinary experiences for our customers, and we believe that your unique skills, passion and superdrive will help us achieve our vision. As a Platform Engineer you’ll be designing, implementing and supporting the various platforms like Rancher, Azure, AWS, GitLab and Cloudflare. This will help us excel at delivering an exceptional gaming experience to our players and stay ahead of the game. What you’ll be doing As part of your role, your responsibilities will include: Infrastructure Design and Management : Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure using platforms like Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Ensure high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance of applications and services, including managing containerized environments. Utilize Rancher for managing Kubernetes clusters, ensuring efficient deployment and orchestration of containerized applications across various environments. Automation and CI/CD Pipeline Development : Build and maintain continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for automated testing, building, and deployment of software. Automate infrastructure provisioning using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or ARM templates. Leverage Rancher’s CI/CD capabilities and integrations to streamline the deployment process for containerized applications in Kubernetes environments. Monitoring and Performance Optimization : Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to track application and infrastructure performance, using tools such as Azure Monitor, Prometheus, or CloudWatch. Use Rancher’s built-in monitoring tools to observe Kubernetes clusters and containers, ensuring that applications are performing optimally. Optimize infrastructure for cost-efficiency and performance, configuring autoscaling and resource management within Rancher-managed Kubernetes clusters. Security and Compliance : Ensure the security of cloud infrastructure by configuring firewalls, access controls, and encryption for sensitive data. Implement security best practices to maintain compliance with industry regulations and standards, including role-based access control (RBAC) within Rancher for managing Kubernetes security. Monitor for security vulnerabilities, manage container security, and perform regular security audits of Kubernetes clusters and cloud resources. Collaboration with Development and Operations Teams : Work closely with software development teams to understand application requirements and provide the necessary infrastructure support, particularly for containerized workloads. Collaborate with operations teams to ensure the smooth operation of deployed services, particularly within containerized environments managed through Rancher. Incident Management and Troubleshooting : Investigate and resolve platform-related issues, including application outages, network failures, and security incidents. Utilize Rancher’s centralized logging and monitoring to quickly identify and troubleshoot issues within Kubernetes clusters. Provide on-call support and contribute to incident response strategies, ensuring minimal downtime and fast recovery of services. System Upgrades and Patching : Manage platform updates, patches, and upgrades to ensure systems remain secure and up-to-date. Plan and execute Kubernetes cluster upgrades and Rancher version updates to stay current with new features and security patches. Ensure that containerized applications remain compatible and functional after updates. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing : Maintain clear, comprehensive documentation of infrastructure configurations, deployment processes, and troubleshooting procedures. Share knowledge of Rancher, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure best practices with team members to improve platform operations and efficiency. Capacity Planning and Scaling : Monitor resource usage and plan for capacity scaling to meet changing business and application demands. Implement scaling strategies for Kubernetes clusters in Rancher, including auto-scaling of pods, nodes, and applications to accommodate varying workloads. Cost Management and Optimization : Track and analyze cloud resource usage and costs to ensure efficient resource allocation. Optimize cloud spending by implementing best practices like reserved instances, spot instances, and resource rightsizing. Use Rancher to monitor the resource consumption of containerized applications and optimize the deployment of Kubernetes clusters to reduce infrastructure costs. Disaster Recovery and Backup Planning : Implement disaster recovery strategies and data backup solutions to minimize downtime and data loss. Regularly test backup systems and recovery procedures to ensure reliability in case of failure, including implementing backup solutions for Kubernetes environments managed through Rancher. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities. You may be required to complete other reasonable duties in order to achieve business objectives. Essential skills you’ll bring to the table The necessary skills that we require for this role include: Several years (typically 3-5 years) of experience in a related field (e.g., systems engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering). Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, and or certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE). Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and effectively Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional teams, with a focus on achieving shared goals Expertise in managing multiple projects simultaneously, with a track record of delivering on time and within scope Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring high standards of quality in all outputs Ability to adapt quickly to changing environments and priorities, maintaining effectiveness in dynamic situations Skills in designing highly available and fault-tolerant systems, ensuring platforms are resilient under various conditions. Proven working experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or ELK stack to monitor the health of infrastructure, applications, and services. Excellent skills in identifying, diagnosing, and resolving infrastructure issues quickly, especially when systems fail or behave unexpectedly. Knowledge of securing infrastructure and applications, including role-based access control (RBAC), encryption, and network security. A solid understanding of Git for source code management, collaboration, and version control, is essential A strong understanding of container orchestration with Kubernetes, particularly in deploying, managing, and scaling containerized applications across multi-cluster environments. Proficiency in configuring and maintaining Rancher for cluster management, along with expertise in implementing security policies, monitoring, and logging within Kubernetes clusters, is essential for optimizing containerized workloads and ensuring high availability, security, and performance. A deep understanding of cloud infrastructure management, such as provisioning and configuring virtual machines, networking, storage solutions, and implementing security best practices like Azure Active Directory and network security groups. Additionally, proficiency in automation and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, along with expertise in Azure monitoring tools like Azure Monitor and Application Insights, is crucial for ensuring high availability, security, cost optimization, and efficient deployment of applications in the cloud. Strong focus on automating manual processes and optimizing workflows for more efficient system management Experience with designing distributed systems, microservices, and understanding the trade-offs between performance, consistency, and scalability. Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve It would be great if you also have some of the following skills: Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry Knowledge of database management systems NoSQL, backup strategies, and scaling database clusters. Proficiency in VMware vSphere, which is the suite of server virtualization products that includes vCenter Server (centralized management platform) and ESXi (hypervisor). Experience with Cloudflare managing CDN, DNS, security features like DDoS protection and WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and Zero Trust access solutions. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We offer a great variety of personal and professional benefits to help you thrive at DigiOutsource and Super Group. Your hard work and achievements won’t go unnoticed. Our innovative Performance Tool ensures you receive regular, constructive feedback, helping you to continuously improve and reach your full potential. It’s all about putting your experience first and ensuring honesty and fairness in all we do. Here, your growth is supported and your contributions valued. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Markets (“RHM”) Compliance team is Robinhood’s parent company group. As the AI Compliance Lead within RHM Compliance, you’ll play a critical role in supporting Robinhood’s development and implementation of Artificial Intelligence. Working with Legal, Engineering, Privacy, and Security and oversight groups across Robinhood, you’ll ensure that the development and use of AI technologies are transparent, ethical, and compliant with relevant regulations. You’ll do significant work on high-priority, cross-functional projects and lead the compliance efforts to further mature, scale, and operationalize the AI Compliance framework, while also supporting Legal and Compliance in adopting AI for their own work. Given the pace of AI adoption, we need someone who can move quickly, make sound decisions, and enable the business while managing risk! This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, Washington, DC and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own and continue to build a cross-Robinhood AI compliance program by developing policies & procedures, oversight & testing, governance, and frameworks, including tools that operationalize AI governance Work with cross functional partners to maintain and enhance a formal risk assessment and mitigation program for AI use cases and capabilities, including generative AI and agentic AI Maintain an enterprise inventory of AI use cases, models, and third-party AI tools, with a risk-tiering and intake process that scales the level of review, testing and monitoring to risk Evaluate and categorize new AI tools and use cases (intended use, data and controls), and develop new models and templates that speed up onboarding and approval Partner with compliance business units (“BU”), enterprise risk management and BU risk to implement Model Validation for AI programs Work with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Engineering, Security and BU compliance to ensure processes are in place for AI regulatory compliance Monitor emerging global AI regulatory frameworks, laws, regulations, policies and trends Remain up-to-date on standards, technical approaches, and related issues by participating in workshops, reading professional publications, maintaining personal networks, and participating in professional organizations Provide regulatory and compliance advice on AI-related efforts, including supporting internal audits and regulatory exams and inquiries Act as the RHM enterprise compliance subject matter expert on AI, facilitating the integration of the AI compliance program and raising awareness around the importance and safe adoption of AI across RH Support Legal and Compliance teams in identifying, evaluating, and responsibly adopting AI for their own use cases (e.g., regulatory change management, monitoring and surveillance, policy and contract review, and compliance testing), including defining appropriate guardrails, testing and human review Participate in committee meetings and present to senior leadership and the boards of Robinhood entities on AI usage, risk analysis, and compliance efforts, and produce clear policies and reports that support a reasonable, well-documented approach to AI risk Develop and deliver practical, example driven training programs for employees on AI ethics, compliance, and responsible AI practices What you bring Bachelor’s Degree, and equivalent experience, in a related field 7+ years of progressive professional experience in Compliance, Legal, Model Risk Management, or Regulatory Tech Advisory, with at least 3+ years directly within a regulated financial services institution, fintech, or broker-dealer environment. Demonstrated experience in AI compliance or AI governance, including assessing use cases, controls, and governance for new AI tools (fintech, technology, or other organizations with AI ethics or compliance functions) Working knowledge of how financial services regulation (e.g., broker-dealer, banking, consumer protection) applies to technology and data-driven products Excellent analytical skills and highly organized, resourceful and committed with experience driving focus, clarity and prioritization in a fast-paced environment, with sound judgment and the ability to make timely, risk-based decisions Pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach to compliance: a track record of enabling the business to move quickly while managing risk, and of knowing when to escalate Strong interpersonal skills and composure in high-profile settings, with the ability to influence cross-functionally and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders Experience drafting and implementing policies, procedures, standards and guidelines Strong technical understanding and deep interest in AI capabilities: the technologies (e.g. machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, large language models, and agentic systems) and the emerging field (e.g. GenAI, AI Governance, Explainable AI (XAI)) Understanding of concepts of equity and fairness, ethics, transparency, interpretability, safety in the context of AI/ML Familiarity with Model Validation concepts (model mechanics, standards, testing and evaluation, data integrity and continuous monitoring) as it relates to AI Working knowledge of Responsible AI policy, governance, trends, frameworks, evaluation techniques for machine learning models, and best practices Experience advising or partnering with Legal and Compliance Teams on technology and AI tools used in their workflows is a plus What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform. We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work. THE OPPORTUNITY - Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference. - Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks. - Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete. - Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises. - Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance. - Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions. - Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production. items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket US operates under CFTC oversight as a regulated prediction market, which means the compliance function carries real regulatory weight. The AML team is responsible for detecting and reporting suspicious activity across a user base that transacts through card, ACH and stablecoin rails, and the work requires both financial crime expertise and the ability to think clearly about a product that looks different from a traditional bank or broker. The team is small and the caseload is real. This hire matters because investigation quality is the core of what we do. You will own your casework, from initial review through SAR filing or documented declination, and your judgment will directly shape how the program holds up to regulatory scrutiny. You will also be a resource for the analysts around you, which means your standards become their standards. The environment moves fast. Polymarket is growing, the regulatory landscape for prediction markets is still developing, and the compliance program is being built to match that pace. If you want a role where the work is clearly defined and the edge cases are rare, this is not it. If you want to do serious investigative work at a company where compliance has a seat at the table, it is. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Investigate escalated cases from transaction monitoring, fraud referrals, market surveillance and sanctions screening for signs of money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud and sanctions evasion. - Analyze funding, withdrawal and trading patterns across card, ACH and stablecoin rails, including linked account activity, to build a clear picture of what a customer is doing and why. - Prepare detailed Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory requirements and internal policy, and document decisions when no SAR is needed. - Review customer identity and profile information to assess whether activity fits the customer's known background and stated purpose. - Support law enforcement requests, subpoenas and 314(a) reviews. - Perform quality control reviews of analyst work and provide direct, actionable feedback as needed. - Help analysts work through complex cases, and develop job aids and training materials that raise the baseline quality of the team's output. items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. ABOUT THE ROLE For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back. We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there. It's early. Interactive Avatars has just come out of closed beta, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on. This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta. THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build. We have the avatar technology and a working early version. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles - Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them - Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves - Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time - Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job - Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business WHO YOU ARE You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly. You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. Recommend performance measures, payout structures, accelerators, and crediting rules that align incentives with company goals. - Model business impact: Build scenarios to assess compensation cost, earnings opportunities, and incentive alignment. Evaluate plan performance and recommend changes as our products, pricing, and go-to-market motion evolve. - Own commission operations: Run the full commission cycle, from source-data validation and crediting through calculations, reconciliation, approvals, and payroll handoff. Create consistent processes for new hires, role changes, departures, and territory or account changes. - Make compensation understandable: Lead plan communications and enablement so employees and managers understand how incentives work. Maintain visibility into compensation spend and proactively flag risks or discrepancies. WHAT YOU BRING - Relevant experience: 4+ years of GTM compensation experience in SaaS or another high-growth industry, with meaningful ownership of both plan design and commission operations. - Autonomy and extreme ownership: A track record of setting priorities, identifying gaps, making sound recommendations, and driving work to completion without close supervision. You know when to resolve requests independently and when to escalate to senior leadership with clear context and a recommendation. - AI perspective and drive: A strong perspective on how AI is changing traditional commissions and compensation plan processing, and a passion for putting that perspective into practice across the business while maintaining accuracy, transparency, and controls. NICE TO HAVE - Evolving business models: Experience with consumption-based, usage-based, or hybrid subscription models. - Systems implementation: Experience implementing or migrating an ICM platform and automating compensation workflows. - Technical fluency: SQL or BI skills to investigate data issues and improve reporting.

items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? You’ll work alongside the Senior Compliance Specialist, Senior Compliance Manager and Head of Compliance. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. Manage policy sign-off, coordinating internal review and documenting every required approval before policies reach operational teams. Liaise with local regulatory partners, in-market legal counsel and external consultants to clarify requirements where published guidance is limited or ambiguous, and flag gaps early. Maintain and update the policy library across all live markets as regulations change, processes evolve or audit findings need remediation. Monitor regulatory developments across active jurisdictions and flag material changes to the Senior Compliance Analyst. Act as the day-to-day compliance contact for operational teams, answering questions and giving written guidance on applying their obligations. Support control testing, audits and regulatory reporting with policy documents and market-specific materials, keeping version control and document registers across all markets in M-Files. Brief operational teams on requirements for new markets through workshops and written guidance, and coordinate sign-off with heads of department while tracking documentation milestones with the Program Manager. Use Jira for task tracking and sign-off workflows, and iterate on modular policy templates to cut build time for each new market. Your track record: A compliance, legal, regulatory or related background, with the ability to read legislation or regulatory guidance and extract what it means operationally. Strong written communication, producing policy documents that are accurate, clearly structured and practically useful to the teams they’re written for. Comfort using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow to work faster and more consistently, while applying your own judgement to validate and finalise outputs. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Sales Development (SDR) based in Japan, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL - Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market. - Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers - Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion. - Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends. - Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop. - Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness. - Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results.
